Rashi on Sotah 6b:10:1.hebrew: קדש הקומץ - שקמצה ונתן הקומץ בכלי שרת, קדש בקדושת קומץ. שהמנחה טעונה ארבע עבודות, כנגד ארבע עבודות של דם זבחים: קמיצה מתוך כלי שרת, כנגד שחיטה, שהסכין של כלי שרת מקדש את הדם; ומתן כלי להקדיש הקומץ בכלי שרת שני, כנגד קבלת דם; הולכה, כנגד הולכה; והקטרת הקומץ, כנגד זריקת הדם:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:10:1.english: The handful was sanctified - That is, he took the handful and placed the handful in a service vessel; it was sanctified with the sanctity of a handful. For the meal-offering requires four acts of service, corresponding to the four acts of service of the blood of animal sacrifices: the taking of the handful from within a service vessel, corresponding to the slaughter, since the knife, [being] a service vessel, sanctifies the blood; and the placing in a vessel, to sanctify the handful in a second service vessel, corresponding to the receiving of the blood; the carrying, corresponding to the carrying; and the burning of the handful, corresponding to the sprinkling of the blood.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:10:2.hebrew: שמת הוא - ושוב אינה שותה, דאמאן בעינן למשרייה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:10:2.english: That he died - And she no longer drinks, for whom would we need to permit her [to]?

Rashi on Sotah 6b:10:3.hebrew: הרי היא ככל המנחות - שאירע בהן פסול בין קמיצה להקטרה, ותישרף למטה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:10:3.english: Behold, it is like all [other] meal-offerings - in which a disqualification occurred between the taking of the handful and the burning [of it on the altar], and it is burned below [i.e., not on the altar].

Rashi on Sotah 6b:11:1.hebrew: ולא הספיק - כהן לאכול את השירים:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:11:1.english: And he did not manage - the priest, to eat the remainder.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:11:2.hebrew: כיפרה - מנחה זו את ספיקה. האי כפרה לאו כפרת עון הוא, ולא הזכרת עון, אלא כפרה הראויה לה קאמרינן, שעשתה מנחה זו בשעת הקטרת קומצה כל מה שיש עליה לעשות, שהרי בהכשר קרבה. יבא וישקה אותה ותיבדק, וכיון דבהכשר קרבה, שיריה נאכלין כל זמן שלא אירע בהן פסול בגופן:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:11:2.english: It atoned - This meal-offering did what was required of it. This "atonement" is not atonement for sin, and sin was not mentioned; rather, we mean the atonement that is fitting for it, in that this meal-offering, at the time its handful was burned, did everything that was incumbent upon it, since it was offered in a valid manner. [The husband] may come and give her to drink, and she will be tested. And since it was offered in a valid manner, its remainder may be eaten for as long as no disqualification has occurred in the remainder itself.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:12:1.hebrew: באו לה עדים שהיא טמאה - אמעיקרא קאי, קודם הקטרה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:12:1.english: Witnesses came to her [and testified] that she is impure - It refers back to the original [case], [where the witnesses come] before the burning [of the handful].

Rashi on Sotah 6b:12:2.hebrew: נמצאו עדיה זוממין - עדי סתירתה, שעל ידיהם באה לכך:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:12:2.english: Her witnesses were found to be conspiring witnesses - The witnesses of her defilement, through whom she came to this [state].

Rashi on Sotah 6b:12:3.hebrew: מנחתה חולין - לא קדושת פה ולא קדושת כלי, ואין מועלין בה, דבטעות הוה. אלמא לא אמרינן תישרף מדרבנן כי נמצאו עדיה זוממין, שמא יאמרו מוציאין מכלי שרת לחול. וש"מ, כי קתני באו לה עדים שהיא טמאה מנחתה נשרפת, מדאורייתא קאמר, דבת מקדש הואי:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:12:3.english: Her meal-offering is non-sacred - It has neither the sanctity of speech nor the sanctity of a vessel, and one does not commit sacrilege through it, for it was [brought] in error. Evidently, we do not say that it should be burned by rabbinic enactment when her witnesses are found to be conspiring witnesses, [out of concern] lest people say that they are taking [offerings] out of sacred vessels to the non-sacred. And we learn from this that when it teaches, "Witnesses came to her that she is defiled, her meal-offering is burned," it is speaking of a Torah-law [requirement], because she was a bat mikdash.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:13:1.hebrew: קלא אית להו - הכל יודעין שהקדישה טעות:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:13:1.english: They have a [public] voice - Everyone knows that she sanctified [the offering] in error.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:14:1.hebrew: כוותיה דרב ששת - דאין המים בודקין סוטה שיש לה עדים:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:14:1.english: In accordance with Rav Sheshet - For the water does not test a sota who has witnesses.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:14:2.hebrew: ולא מטעמיה - דועד אין בה, דההוא לאו לספק סוטה מידריש, אלא לסוטה ודאית בעד אחד. אלא מקרא אחרינא נפקא:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:14:2.english: But not for his reason - For [the verse] "and there is no witness against her" — that is not expounded as referring to a doubtful sotah, but to a definite sotah [whose guilt is attested] by one witness. Rather, [the law that a doubtful sotah is not made to drink when there is a ruling of purity] is derived from a different verse.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:15:1.hebrew: טהורה - "ואם לא נטמאה האשה וטהורה היא ונקתה ונזרעה זרע". והוה ליה למיכתב "ואם לא נטמאה ונקתה" וגו', "וטהורה היא" לדרשה, למידרש הכי: טהורה — נזרעה זרע, ולא שניצולת מן המים מפני שהיו עדים בטומאתה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:15:1.english: Pure - "And if the woman was not defiled, and she is pure, she shall be cleared and shall conceive seed" (Numbers 5:28). The verse should have written "And if she was not defiled, she shall be cleared," etc.; [the words] "and she is pure" are [there] for a derashah, to expound as follows: [If she is] pure, she shall conceive seed — but not [if she is] one who escapes from the water because there were witnesses to her impurity.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:16:1.hebrew: וטהורה - וי"ו יתירא, למעוטי שתלתה לה זכות, דבהא לא אמר קרא ״ונזרעה זרע״:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:16:1.english: And pure - The extra vav comes to exclude [a woman] for whom merit has suspended [the effect of the water], for regarding this case the verse did not say, "and she shall conceive seed."

Rashi on Sotah 6b:17:1.hebrew: היא - ולא הניצולת מן המים על ידי שהיה קלקולה מפורסם לכל, שכבר היו נושאות ונותנות בה לדבר בה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:17:1.english: She - [The verse implies] "she" [is made to drink], and not one who was saved from the water [i.e., who is spared from drinking] because her corruption was publicly known to all, as women were already [engaging in discussion] about her, speaking about her.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:17:2.english: Spinning by the moon - Women spin by [the light of] the moon.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:18:1.hebrew: ופרכינן ורבי שמעון - דאמר אין זכות תולה, נהי דוי"ו לא דריש, מיהו יש לה עדים נפקא מקרא. קשיא, דאתה מוציא שם רע על הטהורות, ויאמרו: עדים היו להם:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:18:1.english: And we challenge: And Rabbi Shimon - who says that merit does not suspend [the punishment]: Granted that he does not expound the letter vav, nevertheless [the exclusion of a woman who] has witnesses is derived from the verse. This is difficult, for you would be spreading an evil name about pure women, and people would say: They had witnesses.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:1:1.hebrew: האומרת טמאה אני - שהודתה לבית דין על קלקולה, שהיו מאיימין עליה, כדתני מתני':
Rashi on Sotah 6b:1:1.english: One who says, "I am impure" - That she confessed to the court about her misconduct, because they would threaten her, as the Mishnah teaches.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:2:1.english: Before it is sanctified - in a service vessel.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:2:2.hebrew: תיפוק לחולין - בפדיון, שלא היה קדושת הגוף אלא קדושת פה, וכל המנחות נפדות כל זמן שלא קדשו בכלי:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:2:2.english: Let it go out to non-sacred status - through redemption, for [the meal-offering] did not yet have bodily sanctity, but only sanctity of speech, and all meal-offerings may be redeemed as long as they have not been sanctified in a vessel.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:3:1.hebrew: אלא לבתר דקדוש - דכלי שרת מקדשין את הראוי להם שלא לצאת עוד לחולין, כדתנן: כל הנוגע בהם יקדש. וליקרב אינה ראויה, שהרי אינה באה אלא להזכיר עונה של זו שתבדק, והרי היא בדוקה ועומדת. ולנדבה נמי לא חזיא להקריבה, דמנחת שעורים אינה כשירה אלא לסוטה ולעומר:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:3:1.english: Rather, after it was sanctified - For service vessels sanctify what is fit for them, so that it can no longer go out to non-sacred use, as we learned: "Anything that touches them becomes sanctified." And it is not fit to be offered, for it comes only to recall the sin of this woman, so that she be tested, and behold, she has already been tested and stands [exposed]. And it is also not fit to be offered as a voluntary offering, for a barley meal-offering is valid only for a sotah and for the omer.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:3:2.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא מים בודקין אותה - אם שתתה עד שלא באו עדים, אלמא בשעה שניתנה בכלי ראויה היתה לכלי שרת, דההיא שעתא בת מיקדשא ומיקרב היא מספק, כשאר מנחת סוטה. הלכך, כי קדיש בכלי שפיר קדיש, ומשום הכי כי אתו עדים איפסלא מהקרבה מכאן ולהבא, ולא נפקא לחולין ונשרפת:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:3:2.english: If you say, granted, that the water tests her - If she drank before the witnesses came, it follows that at the time it was placed in the vessel it was fit for a service vessel, since at that moment it was fit to be sanctified and offered, due to the uncertainty, like the other meal-offerings of a sotah. Therefore, when it was sanctified in the vessel, it was properly sanctified; and for this reason, when the witnesses came, it became disqualified from being offered from now on, but it did not go out to become non-sacred [food], and it is burned.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:4:1.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת אין המים בודקין אותה - הואיל ולא ליבדק עומדת, ולא ראויה היא למנחה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:4:1.english: But if you say that the water does not test her - Since she is not going to be tested, she is not fit for the meal-offering.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:4:2.hebrew: תיגלי מילתא למפרע - דלא היתה ראויה לכלי, ואין כלי שרת מקדשין אלא הראוי להם, כדאמר בזבחים (דף פג.):
Rashi on Sotah 6b:4:2.english: The matter would be revealed retroactively - For [the meal offering] was not fit for the vessel [at the time it was placed in it], and the service vessels sanctify only that which is fit for them, as stated in Zevachim (83a).

Rashi on Sotah 6b:4:3.hebrew: ותיפוק לחולין - בלא פדיון, שקדושת פה שלה וקדושת כלי שלה הכל בטעות, שהיינו סבורים שהיא טעונה מנחה ואינו כן, והקדש טעות אינו הקדש:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:4:3.english: And let it go out to [the status of] non-sacred - Without redemption, for the sanctity of its "mouth" and the sanctity of its vessel are all in error, since we thought that she was required to bring a meal-offering, and this is not so; and a consecration made in error is not a consecration.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:5:1.hebrew: שזינתה בעזרה - לאחר שקדשה בכלי, ועל זנות זה באו העדים, ולא על טומאה של סתירה ראשונה. הילכך, כי קדשה בכלי, בת מקדש ומקרב הואי, דלא הוו לה עדים:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:5:1.english: That she committed adultery in the Temple courtyard - After she was sanctified in the vessel [i.e., after her meal-offering was placed in the sacred vessel], and the witnesses came about this act of adultery, and not about the impurity of the first seclusion. Therefore, when she was sanctified in the vessel, she was [still] fit for the Temple and for offering, since there were no witnesses against her.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:7:1.english: That she needed [to relieve herself] - And they left her, and she went and committed adultery.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:7:2.hebrew: דאטו פרחי כהונה בכיפה - של ראשה תלויים לה, שלא תשמט מידם:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:7:2.english: Is it that the young priests [are] on the cap - of her head? Are they hanging on to her [there], so that she will not slip out of their hands?

Rashi on Sotah 6b:8:1.hebrew: לעולם כדאמרינן מעיקרא - כדהוה סלקא דעתיה ברישא, שעל טומאת סתירה ראשונה באו. ואפילו הכי לא קשיא לרב ששת, דהא דקאמר דכיון דלא חזיא לקידוש תיפוק לחולין, אין הכי נמי, מדאורייתא יצאת לחולין, ומדרבנן היא נשרפת, לפי שאין הכל בקיאין בהלכות לידע שבשביל שהיו לה עדים לא היתה ראויה לקדש, ואתו למימר מוציאין דבר שקידש בכלי שרת לחולין:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:8:1.english: Actually, as we said originally - As it was initially assumed, that [the witnesses] came about the impurity of the first seclusion. And even so, [the objection] is not difficult for Rav Sheshet. For as to what he said — that since she is not fit for sanctification, [the meal offering] should go out to non-sacred status — indeed so: by Torah law it has gone out to non-sacred status, but by rabbinic decree it is burned, because not everyone is expert in the laws to know that it was because she had witnesses [against her] that [the offering] was not fit to be sanctified. And they would come to say that one may remove to non-sacred status something that was sanctified in a service vessel.

Rashi on Sotah 6b:9:1.hebrew: הרי היא ככל המנחות - שנטמאו עד שלא קדשו בכלי, ותפדה, ויביא בדמיה את המנחה:
Rashi on Sotah 6b:9:1.english: Behold, it is like all [other] meal-offerings - that became impure before they were sanctified in a vessel; and it is redeemed, and he brings the meal-offering with its proceeds.

Tosafot on Sotah 6b:11:1.hebrew: קרב הקומץ ולא הספיק כו' - נראה דהוא הדין אם קרב הקומץ ובאו עדים שנטמאה, דאמר נמי "כיפרה ספיקה". דהכי אמר בפרק בתרא דכריתות (דף כו:) גבי חטאת העוף הבא על הספק: אם משמיצה דמו נודע לה שילדה, אסורה אפילו בהנאה, שעל הספק באת — כיפרה ספיקה:
Tosafot on Sotah 6b:11:1.english: "The handful was offered, but he did not manage etc." - It appears that the same law applies if the handful was offered and witnesses came [and testified] that she had become impure, for [the Gemara] also says, "Its doubt has atoned." For so it says in the last chapter of Keritot (26b) regarding a bird sin-offering that is brought for a doubt: If, after its blood was squeezed out, it became known that she had [in fact] given birth, [the offering] is forbidden even for benefit, since it came on account of a doubt — its doubt has atoned.

Tosafot on Sotah 6b:12:1.hebrew: נמצאו עדים זוממין - נראה דאקדשה בכלי קאי, וקודם קמיצה; דלאחר הקמיצה איכא איסורא דרבנן, ונשרפת. דמוקמינן נמי התם הא דתנן "משנמלקה נודע לה — הרי זו תקבר" בנודע לה שלא ילדה, ובדין הוא דמותרת בהנאה. ומאי טעמא תקבר? מדרבנן:
Tosafot on Sotah 6b:12:1.english: The witnesses were found to be conspiring witnesses - It appears that this refers to [a meal-offering] that was already sanctified in a vessel, but before the kemitzah (the taking of the handful). For after the kemitzah there is a rabbinic prohibition, and it is burned. For we also establish there that which we learned, "Once [the bird] had its neck pinched (melikah) and it then became known to her, it must be buried," as referring to where it became known to her that she had not given birth; and by right it should be permitted for benefit. And what is the reason that it is buried? It is by rabbinic law.

Tosafot on Sotah 6b:16:1.hebrew: וטהורה ולא שתולה לה זכות - מהכא משמע דבעלה מותר בה לאלתר, ולא אמרי' ימתין עד שלש שנים שמא זכות תלתה לה. דאם היה אסור בה, היכי הוה מצינו למיקרי בה "ונקתה ונזרעה זרע"? וכן הראני רבי בירושלמי: "ונקה האיש מעון" — אינה חושש שמא תלה זכות. ואתיא כמ"ד הזכות תולה ואינה ניכרת:
Tosafot on Sotah 6b:16:1.english: "And pure" – and not that merit has suspended [the effect] for her - From here it implies that her husband is permitted to her immediately, and we do not say that he must wait three years, lest merit has suspended [the effect] for her. For if he were forbidden to her, how could we have applied to her [the verse] "and she shall be cleared and shall conceive seed"? And so my teacher showed me in the Yerushalmi: "And the man shall be clear of iniquity" — he is not concerned lest merit has suspended [the effect]. And this accords with the one who says that merit suspends [the effect], but [the effect] is not apparent.

Tosafot on Sotah 6b:3:1.hebrew: כי קדוש מעיקרא שפיר קדוש משום הכי נשרפת - קשיא: כיון דהוא היה מביא מנחתו עליה, אמאי נשרפת? מאי שנא מהא דתנן בפרק ד' במסכת נזיר (דף כד:): האשה שנדרה בנזיר, והפרישה את בהמתה בנזיר, והיפר לה בעלה — אם שלו היתה הבהמה, תצא ותרעה בעדר; ואם שלה היתה הבהמה, חטאת תמות. ואע"ג דבשעת הקדש הות בת מקדש — דקי"ל דבעל מיגז גייז — ואפ"ה אמר: כיון דמשלו היתה, תצא ותרעה בעדר, דנפקא לחולין. ותנן נמי התם בפרק בית שמאי (נזיר דף לב.): מי שנדר בנזיר והלך להביא בהמתו — אם עד שלא נגנבה בהמה נדר, הרי הוא נזיר; ואם משנגנבה בהמה נדר, אינו נזיר. והכי נמי הוו עדים בעולם קודם הקדש, ולאו אדעתא דהכי הקדיש. ועוד, אמאי נשרפת? כיון דקי"ל כבית הלל דאמרי בפרק יש נוחלין (ב"ב דף קכ:) ובפרק ב"ש במסכת נזיר (דף לא:) דיש שאלה להקדש — למה אינו נשאל עליה, ותצא לחולין:
Tosafot on Sotah 6b:3:1.english: "When it was sanctified at the outset, it was properly sanctified; therefore it is burned" - This is difficult: Since he was the one who brought his meal-offering on her behalf, why is it burned? How is this different from what we learned in the fourth chapter of tractate Nazir (24b): A woman who vowed to be a nazirite and set aside her animal for her nazirite offering, and her husband annulled [her vow] for her — if the animal was his, it goes out and grazes with the herd; but if the animal was hers, the sin-offering is left to die. And even though at the time of the consecration she was fit to consecrate [the animal] — for we hold that a husband merely [has the power to] shear [the vow, i.e., it is annulled retroactively only from the time of annulment] — nevertheless [the Mishnah] says: Since it was his, it goes out and grazes with the herd, for it passes into non-sacred status. And we also learned there, in the chapter of Beit Shammai (Nazir 32a): One who vowed to be a nazirite and went to bring his animal — if he took the vow before the animal was stolen, he is a nazirite; but if he took the vow after the animal was stolen, he is not a nazirite. And here too, there were witnesses in the world before the consecration, and he did not consecrate with this in mind. Furthermore, why is it burned? Since we rule like Beit Hillel, who say in the chapter Yesh Nochalin (Bava Batra 120b) and in the chapter Beit Shammai in tractate Nazir (31b) that there is release [by a sage] for a consecrated item — why can it not be released [through a sage], so that it goes out to non-sacred status?

Tosafot on Sotah 6b:4:1.hebrew: דכי קדוש מעיקרא בטעות קדוש - ואין להקשות: והא אשם תלוי, אע"ג דכי קדוש מעיקרא בטעות קדוש, דלא חזי לכפר מידי היכא דלא חטא, ואפ"ה תנן בפרק בתרא דכריתות (דף כג:): המביא אשם תלוי ונודע שלא חטא — ירעה עד שיסתאב! דהא מפרש התם טעמא: משום דלבו נוקפו, גמר ומקדיש:
Tosafot on Sotah 6b:4:1.english: For when it was sanctified at the outset, it was sanctified in error - And one should not raise the objection: But what about the asham taluy (the guilt offering brought in a case of uncertainty)? Even though when it was sanctified at the outset it was sanctified in error, since it is not fit to atone for anything where [the person] did not sin, nevertheless we learned in the last chapter of Keritot (23b): One who brings an asham taluy and then learns that he did not sin — [the animal] must graze until it becomes blemished! [This is not a difficulty,] for the reason is explained there: because his heart troubles him, he resolves and sanctifies it [in earnest].

Tosafot on Sotah 6b:8:1.hebrew: גזירה שמא יאמרו מוציאין מכלי שרת לחולין - ואי תקשה: כל הני דתנן "תצא ותרעה בעדר", נגזור שמא יאמרו מוציאין מקדושת הגוף לחולין? תריץ: התם לא מוכחא מילתא, וליכא היכירא בין קדושת פה לקדושת הגוף, ויאמר: קדושת הפה היה. אבל הכא איכא היכירא בין קדושת הפה לקדושת כלי שרת. וצ"ע בפרק שתי מדות (מנחות דף צ.) ובפרק התודה (מנחות דף עט:):
Tosafot on Sotah 6b:8:1.english: It is a decree, lest people say that one removes [items] from sacred vessels to non-sacred use - And if you would object: All these cases that we learned, "it shall go out and graze with the flock" — should we decree [there too], lest people say that one removes [an animal] from bodily sanctity to non-sacred status? Answer: There, the matter is not conspicuous, and there is no distinguishing mark between sanctity of speech and bodily sanctity, so one would say: It was [only] sanctity of speech. But here, there is a distinguishing mark between sanctity of speech and the sanctity of a sacred vessel. And this requires further study in the chapter Shtei Midot (Menachot 90a) and in the chapter HaTodah (Menachot 79b).
